pages.text: Your fast-travel network. Activate waystones by interacting with them. Teleportation is free.$(br2)$(bold)Natural generation:$() Waystones generate naturally in all villages, most structures, and many dimensional spawn points. You don't need to build them — explore to discover them.$(br2)$(bold)Crafting waystones:$() Intentionally expensive. Requires rare boss materials. Designed for establishing outposts far from natural spawns.$(br2)$(bold)Waystone recipes in this pack:$() All crafted waystones require a boss drop material appropriate to the tier of the dimension you're placing them in. You can't build a $(t4)T4$() outpost waystone with $(t1)T1$() materials.$(br2)$(bold)Warp Scroll:$() Single-use teleport to any activated waystone. Craftable from iron + paper. Good emergency tool.
